name: Keeping Quiet
overview: Scripture emphasizes the wisdom and protection found in keeping quiet, urging believers to guard their speech carefully as a means of preserving life and fostering peace. The Psalms call on the Lord to watch over our words, while Proverbs highlights that restraint in speech prevents sin and is a mark of understanding and wisdom. Gentle responses can defuse anger, and even a fool is considered wise when he remains silent, underscoring the spiritual value of measured speech in the believer's walk.
